links.outcome: Readability of chatbot CPR patient education responses versus 6th-grade reading level
links.effect: Readability of responses from all 4 chatbots was above 6th grade on all formulas (P < .001); easiest to hardest: Bard, Perplexity, Gemini, ChatGPT-3.5.
links.quote: The readability of the text content provided by all 4 chatbots was found to be above the 6th-grade level.

screen.reason: Evaluated the readability, reliability, and quality of LLM chatbot responses to CPR queries using standard benchmark scoring rubrics and readability calculators without testing an operational guardrail or deployment practice.
